tab1.role_description: A junior Cloud Engineer in India typically provisions cloud resources using Terraform or CloudFormation, writes IAM policies, configures S3 buckets and EC2 instances, and monitors infrastructure health using CloudWatch. Their week includes responding to infrastructure tickets, reviewing security posture findings, assisting with cost analysis reports, and supporting deployment pipeline maintenance. AWS is the dominant cloud platform for Indian roles. Cloud engineers work in IT services cloud migration practices and product company platform teams - the daily work blends infrastructure scripting, monitoring, and incident support.
tab1.narrative_para1: A junior Cloud Engineer in India typically provisions cloud resources using Terraform or CloudFormation, writes IAM policies, configures S3 buckets and EC2 instances, and monitors infrastructure health using CloudWatch. Their week includes responding to infrastructure tickets, reviewing security posture findings, assisting with cost analysis reports, and supporting deployment pipeline maintenance. AWS is the dominant cloud platform for Indian roles. Cloud engineers work in IT services cloud migration practices and product company platform teams - the daily work blends infrastructure scripting, monitoring, and incident support.
tab1.narrative_para2: GitHub Copilot assists cloud engineers significantly with Terraform, CloudFormation, and Helm chart templates. ChatGPT and Claude help diagnose cloud configuration errors, interpret service logs, and draft runbooks. AI accelerates IAM policy drafting and infrastructure documentation. What remains human: making architectural decisions on cost optimisation and high availability trade-offs specific to a business's actual usage patterns, responding effectively during live cloud outages where rapid contextual judgment is required, and evaluating vendor lock-in trade-offs with business strategy considerations.
tab1.narrative_para3: Cloud engineering suits those comfortable working across both infrastructure and scripting - people who enjoy automating repetitive provisioning tasks but also understand what the infrastructure is running and why it matters. Genuine interest in cloud cost management and comfort with ever-evolving cloud service catalogues are practical requirements. Those who approach infrastructure as code with the same discipline they would apply to application code - modular, reviewed, version-controlled - tend to build the most reliable cloud environments.
tab1.typical_employers_india: Manufacturing Plants, PSUs, EPC Companies, Auto OEMs

ChatGPT/Claude for DevOps troubleshooting helps diagnose cloud configuration errors, interpret service logs, and draft runbooks. AI accelerates cloud resource provisioning scripts, IAM policy drafting, and architecture documentation.
ai_exposure.human_value: Cloud engineers make nuanced architectural decisions on cost optimisation, high availability design, and multi-cloud strategy that require business context AI lacks. Hands-on incident response during cloud outages, negotiating cloud contracts, and evaluating vendor lock-in trade-offs demand experienced human judgment.

tab1.role_description: A Computer Vision Engineer in India builds systems that enable machines to interpret and understand visual information — developing image classification, object detection, image segmentation, and video analysis models for applications in manufacturing quality control, medical imaging, satellite imagery analysis, and autonomous systems. India's computer vision talent base is concentrated in product companies, defence and aerospace GCCs, healthcare AI startups, and agritech firms. Strong deep learning skills combined with expertise in visual data processing are the core requirements.
tab1.narrative_para1: A Computer Vision Engineer in India builds systems that enable machines to interpret and understand visual information — developing image classification, object detection, image segmentation, and video analysis models for applications in manufacturing quality control, medical imaging, satellite imagery analysis, and autonomous systems. India's computer vision talent base is concentrated in product companies, defence and aerospace GCCs, healthcare AI startups, and agritech firms. Strong deep learning skills combined with expertise in visual data processing are the core requirements.
tab1.narrative_para2: AI tools are accelerating Computer Vision development significantly. GitHub Copilot generates PyTorch/TensorFlow model architectures, data augmentation pipelines, and evaluation scripts. ChatGPT and Claude assist with model debugging techniques, CUDA error resolution, and model card documentation. Docker-based GPU training environment configurations are increasingly AI-generated. This is an AI-Evolving role where AI handles code velocity and documentation, while the human value — designing architectures for novel visual domains, managing annotation quality, and deploying models to edge hardware with resource constraints — requires deep hands-on expertise.
tab1.narrative_para3: Computer Vision Engineering suits people who are fascinated by how machines can be made to 'see' and interpret the physical world. If you're motivated by working on high-impact applications — detecting cancer in medical scans, finding defects in manufacturing, or analysing crop health from satellite imagery — and have strong interest in deep learning and GPU-accelerated computing — this is a compelling technical path. Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and OpenCV are the core entry tools; strong mathematics (linear algebra, calculus) underpins effective model design.
tab1.ai_impact: AI tools are accelerating Computer Vision development significantly. GitHub Copilot generates PyTorch/TensorFlow model architectures, data augmentation pipelines, and evaluation scripts. ChatGPT and Claude assist with model debugging techniques, CUDA error resolution, and model card documentation. Docker-based GPU training environment configurations are increasingly AI-generated. This is an AI-Evolving role where AI handles code velocity and documentation, while the human value — designing architectures for novel visual domains, managing annotation quality, and deploying models to edge hardware with resource constraints — requires deep hands-on expertise.

ai_exposure.tasks_assisted: Computer Vision Engineers benefit from AI with GitHub Copilot for ML Code generating PyTorch/TensorFlow model architectures, data augmentation pipelines, and evaluation scripts. ChatGPT/Claude assists with explaining model debugging techniques, CUDA error resolution, and drafting model card documentation. Docker-based container configurations for GPU training environments are increasingly AI-generated.
ai_exposure.human_value: Computer Vision Engineers design custom architectures for domain-specific challenges — medical imaging, satellite data, manufacturing defect detection — requiring deep problem understanding AI cannot contextualise. Collecting and annotating training datasets for novel visual domains, managing annotation quality, and deploying models to edge hardware require experienced hands-on expertise.
